title: Useful failures and mathematical extraction
summary: Two different kinds of residue belong on the wall. GAlinearPredictionNetwork is a clean negative control: cheap scalar trajectory nowcasting made the tested training run slower and exposed the distinction between predicting where weights move and preserving computations under a proposed update. CausalHorizon is already curated elsewhere as a standalone mathematical extraction from several mechanism lines; this pass links that existing node into the same meta-pattern without duplicating it: messy executable systems can leave behind either a killed route that sharpens the next question or a clean algebraic object that survives the original story.

nodes.claim: Tests whether recent neural-network weight trajectories can be cheaply extrapolated to skip real training work, then separates trajectory prediction from compatibility/preservation after the scalar nowcaster loses.
nodes.survived: The benchmark contracts remain useful and the negative result is concrete: in the frozen seed-0 CIFAR-10 run the scalar linear nowcaster used more epochs, more backpropagations and more wall time than plain training. The conceptual residue is that predicting a future parameter point and deciding whether an update is compatible with existing computation are different problems.
nodes.killed: The tested scalar extrapolator is not a training accelerator. The repo does not reproduce or refute learned Weight Nowcaster Networks, and it claims no result for its unfinished joint-operator arms.

edges.why: GAlinearPredictionNetwork explicitly says the stronger question exposed by ThirdWay is compatibility rather than forecasting and hands the lethal-average/structural-growth experiment to ThirdWay instead of continuing to optimize the nowcaster.

motifs.title: Prediction is not preservation
motifs.description: GAlinearPredictionNetwork asks where the optimizer is likely to go and gets a useful negative result. ThirdWay asks a different question: which part of a proposed change can become structure without destroying computations that must remain viable? The distinction blocks a recurring shortcut in which smooth parameter trajectories are mistaken for safe computational trajectories.

motifs.title: A messy mechanism line can leave behind a clean mathematical object
motifs.description: CausalHorizon is deliberately standalone mathematics even though it was motivated by AnttisBrain2, SighImageSuper, GeometricNeuronV24, Operaattori/Jako, Kompressori, JelloBrain and IttnasNoruen. The atlas should distinguish that kind of extraction from ancestry: experiments can motivate an exact finite-dimensional identity without proving that every motivating nonlinear or biological system literally obeys it.
